import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    t = int(next(it))
    a.sort()
    num = 0
    for i in range(n):
        cnt = sum(1 for x in a[i:] if x <= a[i] + t)
        if cnt > num:
            num = cnt
    print(num)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
